pr.body:
Since we'll be doing more with issue occurrences split out the concept
of incidents into it's own logic module, as well as incident_occurrence
into it's own module

Part of GH-80527
pr.title: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic

raw_findings.body: Regressions in try_incident_threshold can go undetected by CI since the only coverage is indirect, through tests/sentry/monitors/logic/test_mark_failed.py, rather than a dedicated test module for the newly split-out logic module
raw_findings.failure_mode: Reduced ability to detect regressions in isolation; failures only surface through integration tests of mark_failed
raw_findings.impact: Regressions in try_incident_threshold can go undetected by CI since the only coverage is indirect, through tests/sentry/monitors/logic/test_mark_failed.py, rather than a dedicated test module for the newly split-out logic module
raw_findings.root_cause: The patch extracts try_incident_threshold into its own module without adding a corresponding dedicated test module, breaking the repo's one-test-file-per-logic-module convention (e.g. mark_failed.py -> test_mark_failed.py)
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add tests/sentry/monitors/logic/test_incidents.py mirroring the test_mark_failed.py pattern to directly exercise try_incident_threshold
raw_findings.title: New incidents.py logic module has no dedicated unit test file
raw_findings.trigger: A future change to try_incident_threshold's threshold/incident-creation logic (e.g. modifying the previous_checkins slicing or incident lookup) is made without touching mark_failed.py
